Test.Description: -- SetupConfig: {} create transformer as begin -- Prepends the @PartDepth as the first column: -- -- in first statement {select DynObjId,} -- begin -- inject " @PartDepth, " after first {select}; -- end -- -- If another package prepends another column, this will fail (this would need to be rewritten). -- TQL could enhance its InScope feature with after/before/between ... and ... suffixes. -- The code would be: in first statement {select} after "--!Header:" -- This way, the injection will always "prepend" even if other transformations prepended stuff... -- -- But a suffix is less "composable" than using InScope composition. So as of November 2019, the -- InScope syntax supports a after/before/between range location. -- in after single "--!Header:" in first statement {select} begin inject " @PartDepth, " after first {select}; end end
